productOnPage.description: Yoto Says: Five inspiring stories of football's biggest modern stars, charting the journeys of Haaland, Yamal, Wirtz, Vinicius Junior and Van Dijk from childhood dreamers to global icons. Ultimate Football Heroes: Men's Global Icons Collection brings together five of the most exciting and influential footballers in the world today. From prolific goalscorers and creative playmakers to defensive leaders, these modern superstars have inspired millions of fans with their talent, determination, and success on the biggest stages in football. Ultimate Football Heroes is a series of biographies telling the life stories of the biggest and best footballers in the world, following their incredible journeys from childhood fans to global superstars. Told in a fast-paced, action-packed style, with immersive sound effects that transport listeners straight onto the pitch, these audiobooks are perfect for football fans of all ages to enjoy together. This collection includes: Ultimate Football Heroes: HaalandUltimate Football Heroes: YamalUltimate Football Heroes: WirtzUltimate Football Heroes: Vinicius JuniorUltimate Football Heroes: Van Dijk DiscoverDiscover the determination, talent, and unforgettable moments that helped these modern football icons rise to the very top of the game. Tracks included: A Trophy for the Terminator Kitted Out Leaving England Greener Beginnings Record Breaker Striker's Instincts Catching the Eye Zlatan Halfway Line Hero A Boy Among Men Debut Day Top Tunes Going It Alone Shining with Solskjaer On Cloud Nine Leading Norway's New Era Owning the Big Stage Dortmund Bound The Bedtime Routine Unleashing the Terminator Chasing the Euro 2020 Dream Overcoming Obstacles Trophy Time Living in the Moment Credits & Audio Sample
